clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952 and the purchase of the orchard, within months: June's anxiety rising as she wrote daily to her sister Edna back in Millbrook, Walter and June distancing as he worked in the trees from dark to dark, Glen fighting at his new school, Walter cutting off from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June keeping to her bed for weeks that first winter, Walter and June in rows over money for new trees, and June's anxiety dropping as she joined the church choir by September 1953. The shifts pile up across a year and a half around the family's major move and its aftermath.

clusters.name: The orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost took the crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter drinking heavily, Walter and Glen in conflict over blame for the loan, Glen and Marian overfunctioning as they took over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worsening that winter, Nora beginning to wet the bed in April 1969, Ida's heart trouble found in May 1969, and Walter stopping drinking by October 1969 as he took work pruning trees. Glen had worked the orchard beside his father since leaving school, so the loss touched the whole household.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975: Glen out of work most of that year sitting in the truck in the yard for hours, loud fights between Glen and Marian at night over money, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night while Glen overfunctioned, Nora stopping eating properly and losing weight that summer, Nora keeping to her room and distancing from Marian, Walter drinking again after six years off it, and Nora eating again and making the track team by June 1976. The shifts show the household's strain as the loss of income rippled through the family.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma selling her farm and moving into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990: Nora and Wilma clashing over the children's bedtimes and meals, Hollis working late and distancing from the kitchen rows, Hollis taking his mother's side, Owen having tantrums at preschool, Wilma taking over Lily's care, Nora's eczema flaring on both hands, Nora and Hollis in rows most nights, and Nora's eczema clearing over the summer after Wilma took a flat in town in June 1991. The shifts show the household reorganizing around a change in who lived there.

periods.name: the year Dad lost his job
periods.words: The one that stands out is the year Dad lost his job, when I was 14.
